hook: HE HAS NOT SAID "I AM *TIRED" IN TWENTY *YEARS
title: F23 · tired · I Am Fine
lines: He stops on the stairs, where nobody can see.
Ten seconds. Then he will go in smiling.
It has been fine for twenty years.
It has been "fine" for twenty years.
Men like him were taught that tired is something you hide.
At dinner, Dadi told a story to nobody in particular.
Even Shiva once stood at a kitchen door with an empty bowl.
"Even Shiva once stood at a kitchen door with an empty bowl.
He learned you cannot call the body an illusion.
He learned you cannot call the body an illusion."
The room went quiet. Then his wife put her hand on his.
Saying it is not weakness. It is where rest begins. That is sadhana.
